d: What is the Magnus effect and why do soccer balls curve? In this video, we explain the Magnus effect in simple words — from how spinning creates a pressure difference using Bernoulli's principle, to why soccer free kicks curve, how cricket bowlers swing the ball, and how baseball pitchers throw curveballs. Learn why the 2010 FIFA World Cup ball was so controversial, and how ships use Flettner rotors to harness the Magnus effect for propulsion.
